title: Navbar Dropdown Default Element Color
description: Navbar dropdown text should default to element gray, emphasize on hover/selection only.
summary: Fixed navbar and dropdown default text color to element gray. Changed `--color-popover-foreground` token from `--foreground` to `--border-element-color` in ui.css so all popover/select/hover-card surfaces inherit element gray. Added explicit `text-element` to `menuListItemClassName` and `SelectTrigger`. Updated `CommandGroup` from `text-foreground` to `text-element`. Aligned `ActionDropdown` menu rows with `menuListItemClassName` and active selection uses `bg-active-base text-emphasized`. Select-related vitest tests pass.
